# Agent guidance

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before changing or reviewing code.

- Investigations and reviews are read-only unless edits are requested.
- Preserve unrelated changes and staging. Use an isolated worktree for PR work or a dirty
  checkout unless asked otherwise.
- Do not stage, commit, tag, or push unless explicitly requested. Never force-push or rewrite
  pushed commits. Do not change GitHub state; draft comments and reviews for the maintainer.
- Stage explicit paths only. Keep local maintainer notes and exploratory examples out of commits
  unless requested.
- Run the contributor checks on final code or example changes. For documentation-only changes,
  check links and formatting. Report failed or skipped checks and whether the change is breaking.
- Keep replies and GitHub drafts concise. Finish changes with a drafted conventional commit
  message; drafting does not authorize committing.
- Keep this file short. Do not duplicate contributor guidance or add repository skills unless asked.
